original: 夫唯**不争**，故天下**莫能与之争**。
vernacular_zh: 正因不争，天下没有人能与他相争。
translation_en: It is because he is thus free from striving that therefore no one in the world is able to strive with him.

scripture.text_zh: 就自己卑微，存心顺服，以至于死，且死在十字架上。所以神将他升为至高。
scripture.text_en: He humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross. Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name.

insight_zh: 老子：不争，**天下莫能与争**；保罗：卑微至死，**神升他为至高**。
insight_en: Laozi: free from striving, **none can strive**. Paul: humbled, then **highly exalted**.
